statusReason: 单机闭环、美术、性能、移动端与 E2E 已通过；联机房间/邀请/跨设备同步/AI 补位/断线重连/超时托管/排行榜/双端 E2E 全部接入并通过。

e2e.environment: resident audit Chrome via CDP 9222; chrome-ensure reuse; one tab opened and closed; no temp Chrome/profile

online.environment: resident Chrome via chrome-ensure + Playwright connectOverCDP; two isolated contexts; no browser.close()

modeLabel: 2–4 人 · 联机 + AI 匹配 / 单人 AI

online.transport: HTTP/JSON + 700ms polling; server-authoritative; LAN-only by default

features.rooms: 2–4 seats; room id + 6-char code + single-use invite token
features.invite: inviteUrl uses the request Host; opens /boardgame/azul-premium/online.html?room=&code=
features.stateSync: stateVersion + lastAction; every viewer gets players rotated so its own seat is 0
features.aiFill: default 3s, configurable; fills empty seats to 2/3/4 with the same Azul engine and legal-move AI
features.reconnect: session token + POST /api/rooms/:id/reconnect; reconnect clears the timeout autopilot flag
features.timeoutTakeover: no session request for BOARDGAME_DISCONNECT_MS (default 15s) → server auto-plays; autoPlayed records reason=timeout
features.leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard?game=azul; anonymous sha256(playerId) only; AI participants included
features.idempotency: per-player idempotencyKey is checked before the turn guard, so replays keep the original response

evidence.browser: node games/boardgame/azul-premium/online-e2e.mjs — 42 assertions, two Playwright CDP contexts
evidence.reuse: resident Chrome via chrome-ensure + connectOverCDP; no temp Chrome/profile; no browser.close()

shared.shuffle: games/shared/shuffle.js — engine.js require + index.html script tag; seeded Fisher-Yates reused
shared.sfx: games/shared/sfx.js — index.html script tag; AudioContext/合成器不再自建
shared.rules: N/A — games/shared/rules.js 只含五子棋/四子棋；Azul 规则在 engine.js
shared.rewards: N/A — Azul 联机不引入积分/奖励层
shared.leaderboard: 复用 games/boardgame/app/leaderboard.js 的 sha256Hex；服务端内存榜只存匿名摘要

dimensions.note: 盒子与玩家板来自公开评测/BGG；花砖 22×22×6 mm 为社区实测，官方 Next Move 只标注 100 枚树脂砖。

materials.artDirection: glazed ceramic tile faces, walnut factory trays, wool felt table
materials.deviation: 材质为 premium 视觉升级；规则、颜色、件数、比例严格按官方。
